summary: Iteration 6 — Re-test of the claimed PATCH /api/payments/{pid} fix from the developer agent. RESULT: The fix was NOT applied. /app/backend/server.py lines 877–915 still contain only GET/POST/POST(bulk-delete)/DELETE for /payments — no @api.patch handler exists. Live curl against the public URL confirms: POST /api/auth/login (owner) OK, GET /api/payments returns the seeded payment (id=bbffc0d0-5bd0-4b57-b41d-bf18f5e76f0f, 'Prueba pago editable'), then PATCH /api/payments/{id} with {amount:777, concept:'Editado desde PATCH'} → HTTP 405 {"detail":"Method Not Allowed"}. Existing 13 pytest cases still pass (regression clean). Frontend /pagos edit-payment and /promesas edit-promise flows therefore remain broken exactly as reported in iteration 5. Frontend UI re-test was skipped because the underlying backend defect is unchanged — the UI outcome is deterministic (same 405 toast as iteration 5). No files modified: adding the endpoint is business logic and belongs to the developer agent.

critical.issue: STILL returns 405 Method Not Allowed. The handler described in the review_request ('added a hand-written PATCH handler right before DELETE /payments/{pid}') is NOT present in /app/backend/server.py. Between the POST /payments/bulk-delete (line 905) and DELETE /payments/{pid} (line 912) there is no @api.patch decorator. Reproduce: curl -X PATCH $BACKEND/api/payments/<any-id> -d '{"amount":777}' → 405.
